caption:
HPE stock fell 16% on Tuesday even though quarterly sales jumped 50% to $14.5 billion.
The reason: more of its sales are AI servers built with pricier parts, so its gross margin slipped to 38.2%, and its CFO expects it to keep moderating.
CEO Antonio Neri expects memory and other parts to stay scarce until at least the second half of 2028.
